GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well led x 1.5l home turn led x 1 length dug deep last 100 # led/game

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & worked home OK Two Wide in last 100m. # Good 1st-up effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased approaching the 800m when momentarily placed in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began awkwardly, raced very Wide early stages Settled Down Mid Field 4l before being ridden forward to settle outside the leader 1000 1 length home turn 0.5l comes Middle Of Track Under Pressure 200m fc2. r- anticipated a strong tempo attempted to ride in a conservative manner but when early tempo was slower than expected allowed mount to stride forward. Under pressure 500 failed to respond,attributed too soft track conditions. End of preparation # used early/spell
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide in the early stages until settling outside the leader near the 1000m. Rider stated he attempted to ride more conservatively however with the lack of tempo he allowed his mount to stride forward. He added it failed to respond when placed under pressure and may not have been suited by the soft track conditions.
